Name: LG Electronics
Description:
Step into the world of LG Electronics, a global innovator in technology and consumer electronics focused on creating solutions for a better life. Guided by our brand promise, Life’s Good, we aim to make everyday life better, smarter and more meaningful for people around the world.

With a history spanning more than six decades, a network of more than 100 subsidiaries, and an international workforce of over 75,000, LG Electronics operates on a truly global scale. Since our founding in 1958, we have remained focused on delivering innovative products and technologies that improve lives around the world.

Through our four business divisions — Home Appliance Solution, Media Entertainment Solution, Vehicle Solution, and Eco Solution Companies — we provide innovative products and services that enhance everyday life across residential, entertainment, mobility, and HVAC sectors.

At the same time, we continue to expand into new growth areas including AI Home, smart factories, robotics and platform-based services such as webOS, building on our strengths in both consumer technology and B2B solutions.

Our management philosophy, Jeong-do Management, reflects our commitment to integrity, transparency and doing business the right way. Built on the principles of customer value creation and people-oriented management, our culture encourages collaboration, creativity and growth.

Join us as we continue to shape what comes next, because at LG, Life’s Good.

Name: WEG
Description: Founded in 1961, WEG is a global electro-electronic equipment company, operating in the capital goods sector a with focus on electric motors, gearboxes and drives and controls, energy generation and transformers, electrification products and systems, automation and digitalization. WEG stands out in innovation by constantly developing solutions to meet the major trends in energy efficiency, renewable energy and electric mobility. With manufacturing units in 15 countries and present in more than 135 countries, the company has more than 47,000 employees worldwide. WEG’s net revenue reached R$ 38.0 billion in 2024, 57.0% from external markets.

Name: Dyson
Description:
Dyson solves real-world problems and creates better products through the application of engineering, science, design and creativity. It is a family-owned, global technology company, founded by Sir James Dyson who remains at the helm alongside his son Jake. 

Since inventing the first cyclonic bagless vacuum cleaner, the DC01, Dyson has consistently invested in research and development to improve its products and technologies radically. Dyson offers products across a growing range of areas: floorcare, air purification, robotics, haircare including formulations, lighting, hand drying, and most recently audio. Dyson continues to expand into new areas.

Today, Dyson sells products in more than 80 markets, has 450 Dyson stores worldwide and is available in all major technology and beauty retailers. Dyson has global headquarters in Singapore and major technology campuses in Singapore, the UK, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Its global team of engineers, scientists and software developers are focused on developing technology-enabled products which work better and which people love to use. Key areas of focus have included high-speed electric digital motors, sensing and vision systems, robotics, machine learning and aerodynamics. 

Beyond products, to encourage an inventive future, Dyson is also inspiring the next generation of engineers and inventors through the Dyson Institute of Engineering and Technology, the James Dyson Foundation and the James Dyson Award.  

The Dyson family applies its problem-solving approach in other fields, and established Dyson Farming in 2012. It is one of the largest farming businesses in the UK, extending to 36,000 acres across Lincolnshire, Oxfordshire, Gloucestershire and Somerset. It is a family-owned enterprise unlike any other, focussed on long-term investment in British farming and the countryside to grow tasty and nutritious food.

Name: Arduino
Description: Arduino is the global leader in open-source hardware and software, designed from inception to provide an accessible platform and ecosystem for creativity and innovation. With over 30 million developers worldwide, Arduino’s solutions offer a powerful answer to the talent shortage in engineering and break free from vendor lock-in with a robust line of open-source products enabling IoT, automation, Industry 4.0, and machine learning at the edge. Hundreds of thousands of engineers, designers, students, and makers around the world are using Arduino to innovate in product development, education, industrial automation, smart homes, farming, fashion, music, autonomous vehicles, and more.

Name: Mouser Electronics
Description:
Mouser Electronics is a worldwide leading authorized distributor of semiconductors and electronic components from over 1,200 manufacturer brands, with local sales and service centers around the globe. We specialize in the rapid introduction of new products and technologies for design engineers and purchasing professionals. Our extensive line card includes semiconductors, interconnects, passives, and electromechanical components.

In 2007, Berkshire Hathaway, Inc., acquired TTI, Inc, which included Mouser Electronics. Today, Buffett's holdings include insurance and finance subsidiaries and businesses ranging from jewelry and furniture to manufactured homes.

With a strong commitment to customer service and quality, we're proud to offer the widest selection of the newest semiconductors and electronic componentsTM from our industry-leading manufacturer partners.

Name: XP Power
Description:
We are committed to being a leading provider of power solutions, including AC-DC power supplies and DC-DC converters, high voltage power supplies and RF power supplies.

Offering total quality, from in-house design in Asia, Europe and North America through to leading-edge manufacturing facilities around the world.

Name: Nice Group
Description: Founded in the early 1990's, Nice is a global leader in Home Management Solutions, offering a complete range of integrated solutions for gate automation, garage doors, solar shading systems, parking systems, wireless alarm systems and home security, for residential, commercial and industrial applications; smart and connected systems for residential and commercial applications, for the security, access control, AI (Artificial Intelligence), comfort & wellness, control and power/AV sectors. Nice has embarked on a strategic path of expansion and extension of its portfolio of connected solutions and platforms, to offer a wide choice of customisable solutions and ease of use for the end user. This is complemented by strengthening and expanding in markets with high growth potential, as well as a renewed branding activity to compete in new market segments. Today Nice can rely on an organisation of more than 2,000 people on 5 continents, boasting a wealth of different skills and cultures, as well as 15 R&D centres and 15 production plants serving its partners and customers in over 100 countries worldwide.

Name: Profoto
Description:
WE ARE THE LIGHT SHAPING COMPANY 

Profoto makes photography lighting equipment and is within its niche the largest and most renowned company in the world. In other words, the world’s best photographers, fashion photographers in particular, use Profoto lighting. Profoto has a turnover of 700 MSEK, its headquarters in Sweden, subsidiaries in New York, Tokyo, Hamburg, Paris, London and Scandinavia, and distributors in nearly 50 countries. The business scope includes both the technical development and the selling of premium lighting products to the best photographers in the industry. The company was founded in 1968. Today, Profoto combines its heritage of photographic excellence with a young, dynamic and disciplined culture. This combination has during the last ten years turned Profoto into one of the most profitable and respected companies in the business.

_________

OUR PEOPLE VISION

At Profoto you will be participating in building a world leading innovative company. Today we set the standard with our products as the premier choice of professional photography. With a strong commitment to innovation, we aim to remain the leader in our industry. Brilliant ideas, ground breaking research, as well as sustainable and profitable growth of our business, can only come to life with the right people. 

At Profoto we only hire the best and we invest in the development of our people to ensure we are an employer of choice for those who value professional development and continuous challenges.

We are committed to growth and we want our people to grow with us. To achieve this we offer an ambitious, high quality and demanding culture where we value to have fun together as we build a world class company with a premium brand. We strongly believe that a healthy work life balance, a coaching leadership and individual development are the keys to our success.

Name: FOSS
Description:
FOSS is known throughout the world for efficient, analytical solutions that help to improve both food quality and safety in the global food market. And we are playing an increasingly important role in ensuring optimal use of valuable agricultural resources and have created groundbreaking innovations throughout the years in analytical technology. FOSS provides instruments and solutions to the world’s 100 largest food companies and for over sixty years, FOSS has been at the forefront of creating analytical technology.

Did you know that.... 

- 85% of the world’s milk production
- 80% of grain traded on the world market

...is tested using a FOSS solution? 

FOSS employs around 1,700 people working all over the world including almost 800 in Denmark. The analytical instruments are marketed and sold through a global network of sales subsidiaries in over 32 countries and by more than 75 dedicated distributors spread over Europe, North, South and Central America, Africa, Asia, and Australia.

Name: Genelec
Description: Genelec is the leading manufacturer of Active Loudspeakers for Studio Monitoring, Installations and Home Theaters. Based in Iisalmi, Finland the company has been dedicated to the professional audio business for over 40 years. Our unrivalled commitment to research and development has resulted in a number of industry firsts and established Genelec as the industry leader in active monitors. Genelec monitoring products remain true to our original philosophy from 1978 offering reliability, neutral sound reproduction regardless of size, as well as the ability to adapt frequency response to the listening environment.

Name: Fagerhult
Description:
Fagerhult creates premium lighting solutions that enhance human well-being in professional and public environments. With sustainability and connectivity at heart, we focus on office, education, healthcare, retail and outdoor applications.  We work closely with customers and partners in the European market and provide lighting solutions globally – with tailor-made solutions for our customers. 

The Fagerhult brand includes both the product company Fagerhults Belysning AB (based in Fagerhult, Sweden) and 12 sales companies located around Europe. Based on knowledge of the positive impact of light on humans, we develop and produce innovative lighting solutions that are marketed and sold via Fagerhult's sales company. In total, we are about 1,000 people, of which close to 37% are women and 63% men. (Figures from 31 December 2022)

Fagerhult is part of the Fagerhult Group, one of Europe's leading lighting companies, with 12 different brands and 4,100 employees in 27 countries around the world.

Name: Autel Energy
Description: Autel Energy is a provider of EV charging products and services. Originally stemming from years of R&D, quality manufacturing, and industry leading after-sales service, we believe our smart charging solutions will help accelerate the transition to renewable energy and create a sustainable future. Join us in Powering the Planet together.

Name: Hanley Energy
Description:
Hanley Energy are global innovators in Critical Power and Energy Management solutions, with a stable of world-class engineers shared between European headquarters in Ireland (County Meath) and North America (Ashburn, VA).

Our core capabilities cover the design, build, and commission of turnkey mission-critical solutions – delivering secure and reliable power from the grid all the way to the Hyperscale Data Center IT rack.

Our advisory capability guides customers through the challenges of technology transformation allowing the realisation of operational efficiencies underpinned by Lifecycle Management, Service and Maintenance.

In this way, we enable our clients to effectively manage their energy strategy, ensure 100% up-time and optimise their operational competitiveness.

Our approach is to develop trusted partnerships with clients, as a specialist integrator, ensuring excellent delivery coupled with cost-effective technology solutions.

Our values are: Service Excellence + Quality + Innovation + Partnership
	•	 Service Excellence: Committed to superior customer service.
	•	 Quality: Strive for technical excellence and high-impact results.
	•	 Innovation: Being innovative to achieve exemplar solutions.
	•	 Partnership: Building mutual trust and dependability.

Name: GPV
Description:
GPV is one of Europe’s leading EMS (Electronics Manufacturing Services) companies. Our vision is to be our customers' most trusted, powerful, and top-of-mind EMS partner.

With more than 7,500 employees worldwide and a 2025 turnover of DKK 8.7 billion (EUR 1.2 billion), GPV is the second-largest EMS company headquartered in Europe. From our headquarters in Denmark, we operate electronics, mechanics, and cable-assembly manufacturing in 11 countries worldwide: China (2), Denmark (1), Estonia (1), Finland (1), Germany (1), Mexico (1), Slovakia (2), Sri Lanka (1), Sweden (1), Switzerland (1), and Thailand (2).

Our customers are typically among the very best in their niche, and they expect more than manufacturing excellence. With over 65 years of EMS experience, we combine operational excellence with long-term, trust-based partnerships that enable our customers to gain more — more time, more growth, more cash flow, and more sustainable profitability.

To further strengthen customer service and supply-chain resilience in response to changing global trade dynamics, in December 2025, GPV entered into a strategic partnership with East/West Manufacturing Enterprises (EWME), a US-based EMS provider with production in Austin, Texas. The partnership enhances manufacturing flexibility across the United States and Mexico, supporting customer requirements related to US domestic production, Buy America / Build America (BABA), USMCA compliance, and evolving tariff environments.

At GPV, partnership is proven through action. Every day, we work to deliver timely, faultless, and high-quality solutions, while remaining a reliable and proactive partner in an increasingly complex global environment.

GPV has been part of the Danish industrial conglomerate Schouw & Co. since 2016 and is jointly owned by Schouw & Co. (80%) and Ahlström Capital (20%).

Name: ZAPI GROUP
Description:
ZAPI GROUP is engineering the transition to an all-electric future with a highly integrated product portfolio with motion controllers, electric motors, high-frequency battery chargers, and autonomous navigation software for application in full-electric, hybrid vehicles and system integration. 

As a global electrification leader with deep systems experience, leading innovations, and an obsession with driving customers' success, ZAPI GROUP now counts more than 1700 employees worldwide with total annual revenue of more than 600 million €.

Name: Carlo Gavazzi Automation
Description:
Carlo Gavazzi is an international group engaged in the design, manufacturing, and marketing of electronic control components for the global building and industrial automation markets.

Its factories in Italy, Mexico, Lithuania, Malta, and China are certified to ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 standards. 

The company’s product portfolio—including sensors, solid-state relays, energy meters and analyzers, IoT energy management systems, monitoring relays, soft starters, timers, power supplies, and safety devices—delivers comprehensive automation solutions for both industrial and building applications. 

Typical customers include original equipment manufacturers in sectors such as access control, agriculture, conveyors, distributed energy resources, energy efficiency, energy storage, EV charging infrastructure, food & beverage, HVAC, mobile equipment, plastics & rubber, and semiconductors. In addition, system integrators and distributors play a key role as effective market channels. 

Carlo Gavazzi markets its products worldwide through 23 wholly owned sales companies and approximately 60 independent national distributors, covering Europe, the Americas, and the Asia-Pacific region.

Name: Mycronic
Description:
Mycronic has been a trusted partner to electronics and display manufacturers worldwide for more than 50 years. Today we are at the forefront of innovation in the SMT, semiconductor and automotive industries use our innovative products, services and solutions to create tomorrow’s electronics – from advanced displays to life-saving medical implants and the next generation of satellites. 

Although headquartered in Sweden, our four divisions: Pattern Generators, PCB Assembly Solutions, Assembly Solutions High Volume and Global Technologies makes us a global organization; with subsidiaries, agents and distributors in more than 50 countries. This enables us to combine deep market insight with fast, reliable support, helping our customers achieve efficient production. 

At Mycronic, diversity is more than a value — it’s our strength. Being a company built on passion, collaboration and outside-the-box thinking, a diverse workforce and inclusive culture fuels innovation and strengthens our connection to customers and the various in which we operate. Quite simply, our diversity is our competitive edge. 
Electronics touch every corner of our lives. Through our technological expertise, innovative spirit and passionate teamwork, we help make the world smarter, brighter and more sustainable, for people everywhere, every day. Together with our customers, we are committed to extending the frontiers of of electronics technology. Because with each breakthrough, the impossible becomes possible. Our mission is clear: to bring tomorrow’s electronics to life.

Name: Helvar
Description:
Helvar specialises in intelligent lighting solutions and creating Brighter Spaces that enhance wellbeing, save energy, and generate valuable insights through digital services. 

Drawing on over 100 years of expertise, Helvar’s solutions play an instrumental role in the transition to a more sustainable built environment, and can be found in projects all around the world spanning from hospitals, schools and workplaces to cruise ships, airports and stadiums. 

Helvar serves its customers locally with offices in Finland, UK, Poland and Sweden and via a global network of 85+ Partners around the world. To learn more, please visit helvar.com.

Name: Easy-Laser
Description:
Easy-Laser is one of the world’s leading manufacturers and suppliers of laser measurement systems for all types of industry. We provide extreme accuracy and precision. But that’s not what sets us apart. Today, when virtually anyone with a decent laser can do “straight”, to get ahead, you need to be a bit more forward-thinking.

Because, in the long run, what really counts is neither the absolute straightness of an individual component nor the precise alignment of shafts. It's what these measures add up to: Increased productivity and the saving of resources. Those are the things we ultimately deliver. And from that perspective our most important task is to help you make the road leading there as free from bumps and bends as possible.

That means developing user-friendly measurement and alignment systems that are as easy to get your head around, as they are versatile and scalable. It also means shortening delivery times, extending warranties and optimizing training and support.

Moreover, you can always expect us, or any of our partners, to give you an honest opinion on which of our products are crucial to your operations and which you can do without. What really needs to be aligned and what not. So that what we offer you is a solution perfectly aligned with your needs – and your budget.

Regardless of whether you're a service technician, a purchaser or the CFO of a multinational industrial group, you'll find Easy-Laser truly easy to deal with. Or as we like to put it – straightforward by all measures.

Name: Rolec
Description:
Rolec is a multidivisional manufacturer with over 35 years of experience in the outdoor electrical equipment  industry. With divisions in EV charging, marina services and caravan hook-ups, Rolec's products can be seen across some of the most prestigious and well-established destinations in the world.

As the demand for electric vehicles and charging infrastructure increases, Rolec remains one of the largest manufacturers and suppliers of EV chargepoints, providing both domestic and commercial properties with robust charging solutions. From serving blue chip corporations to independent businesses, Rolec has the solution for businesses and organisations of all shapes, sizes and disciplines. With a combination of native OCPP compliant and compatible hardware and software, Rolec's smart solutions have supported numerous fleets, public destinations and workplaces with their electrification plans.

Name: Kanthal
Description:
Electrification of heating processes is a key enabler for a fossil-free industry. As a world leader in sustainable heating technology, Kanthal collaborates with energy-intensive industries such as steel, cement, petrochemical and battery to develop electric heating solutions that help minimizing their carbon footprint.

Kanthal has provided industry-leading electric heating technology to the world since 1931, when metallurgist Hans von Kantzow founded the company in Hallstahammar, Sweden, based on his discovery of the FeCrAl (iron-chrome-aluminum) alloy.

Over the years we’ve built the largest product range of resistance heating solutions for industrial applications on the market. Our ability to develop and melt specific alloys and convert them into wire, strip, tubes and plates allows us to offer heating materials as well as heating elements and complete heating solutions to our customers.

Today we’re a truly global company with production units and sales offices all around the world.

Take a look at our career opportunities!

Name: APEM
Description:
Dream up your wildest HMI. We can make it happen.

At APEM, we are able to design and manufacture any Human Machine Interface, whatever your requirements may be. Our extensive experience enables us to develop unique switches, joysticks and panel solutions with our customers that meet the highest standards.
Our motto? Bringing our customers' projects to life. From the design to the production of interfaces fully customized to their needs, we do everything possible to provide products and services of the highest quality and reliability. 
Today, APEM is partner to thousands of companies throughout the world. 
Our interfaces equip all kinds of machines and off-road vehicles, which must be able to operate in the most extreme conditions.

Name: Inmotion
Description: Inmotion is a premier global supplier of electric motors, motor controllers, and auxiliary equipment for the vehicle industry. We achieve best in class reliability and on-time delivery, as well as localized supply of products in the major manufacturing regions around the globe, through superior design and world-class manufacturing processes.

Name: Ferroamp
Description: Ferroamp is a Swedish greentech company focused on energy and power optimization of properties. The Ferroamp system maximizes the benefits of solar panels, electric vehicle charging, and battery storage by connecting them to a DC grid, allowing property owners to control and manage their electricity usage and take control of their grid connection.

Name: PCB Connect Group
Description:
Welcome to PCB Connect Group – your trusted partner in printed circuit boards. Our journey began in 2004, and since then, we have grown into one of the industry's leading suppliers, driven by our core values that prioritize making a difference, embracing flexibility, providing global availability with a local touch, fostering transparency, and focusing on sustainability. 

Services – We Make a Difference:
When you choose us, you're not just getting circuit boards; you're getting a team of experts who take ownership and act swiftly and effectively to ensure your success.

Flexibility – Your Needs, Our Solution:
Our can-do mentality drives us forward in a world that never stops changing. We don't believe in limitations; we believe in finding the right solutions for your PCB needs. 

Availability – Global Partner With a Local Presence:
Our strategically placed regional businesses in 17 countries offer you a tailored, personalized experience that perfectly aligns with your PCB supply chain needs.

Transparency – Crossborder Communication:
We are committed to providing the most transparent PCB purchasing process, ensuring you are informed at every step. You can focus on what matters to your organization, knowing that our secure processes are tirelessly working for you.

Sustainability – Long-Term Focus:
Our commitment to sustainability extends beyond environmental concerns. It encompasses a long-term focus that builds stable, high-quality solutions for your PCB needs and continuously driving improvements to enable possibilities for your business to thrive.

If you are ready to experience the PCB Connect difference, we invite you to contact us through our website. Whether you have inquiries, require technical assistance, or want to explore partnership opportunities. Our user-friendly contact page allows you to reach out to us effortlessly; https://www.pcbconnectgroup.com/contact/

Name: Noratel
Description:
Noratel was established in 1925.  We are today servicing industry worldwide as a leading global provider, proud to offer the most comprehensive range of transformers, reactors and power supplies. The major part of Noratel production is dedicated to custom design and manufacturing to meet the requirements of OEM customers.

Noratel employs 2000+ people worldwide. Corporate headquarters is based in Hokksund, Norway. 

Noratel is a part of discoverIE Group Plc. The Group is listed on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is a member of the FTSE 250 Index, classified within the Electrical Components and Equipment subsector, and has revenue of  £450m. 

Noratel is strategically located in key regions throughout the world, including in-house manufacturing in:
• China
• Sri Lanka
• India
• USA
• Canada
• Mexico
• Poland
• Germany
• Nordic countries


Noratel is supplying products and solutions to world leading industrial companies in a range of market segments:

- Renewable Energy
- Automation
- Medical
- Rail
- eMobility
- Motor Drives
- Ship & Offshore
- Audio

Noratel consider quality to be of paramount importance. Our years of success are derived from the quality of products and services we offer.

Noratel's quality administration systems conform to the ISO 9001:2015 and 14001:2015 environmental standards, with all products following the RoHS directive 2015/863/EU (ROHS3).

Noratel has also implemented ISO 13485:2016 for medical transformer products.

Noratel is an APQP4Wind company member.

Name: Elonroad
Description:
Traditional charging stations often cause downtime and inefficiency. Elonroad's in-road conductive charging system offers a superior solution. Our ground-integrated rails enable 24/7 charging, whether parked or driving, eliminating idle time. 

1. Investment saving

25-40% Total Cost of Ownership reduction and a 40% decrease in CO2 impact by lowering demand on batteries and grid capacity.


2. Flexible & efficient operations

Vehicle agnostic and can be retrofitted. To be used while driving or parked for increased uptime and efficiency.

3. Future-proof

Modular upgradable systems.
Ready for autonomous vehicles.

Charging stations, electric roads, and digital solutions for logistics and delivery companies, ports, and public roads.

Name: NCAB Group
Description:
NCAB Group is a leading global producer of printed circuit boards, also referred to as PCBs.

As a leading PCB supplier, we work closely with both our customers and our factories to produce reliable circuit boards in a sustainable way at the lowest total cost through our competence, delivery accuracy and product quality.

At NCAB Group, we serve demanding customers for whom the PCB is a strategic product throughout the entire product life cycle. We therefore make sure that our specialists oversee that the production – from design to prototyping up to volume – is working according to our processes and product specification. We make sure that your PCBs are not only reliable, but also delivered on time.

NCAB Group is a global company with offices in 19 countries all over the world. This allows us to offer competitive terms, quality, and delivery assurance that broaden your production possibilities. We also work with a wide range of PCBs. The different types of PCBs in our portfolio includes Flex PCBs, HDI PCBs, multilayer PCBs and more.

For more information about NCAB Group, visit our company site at www.ncabgroup.com , or our career site at www.ncabgroup.com/career/

And if you’re interested in becoming a customer, or want to get into contact, you can reach us at www.ncabgroup.com/contact/

Name: Charge Amps
Description:
We create smart charging solutions for electric vehicles through Swedish innovation and sustainable design. We believe charging your electric vehicle should look great, be easy to use and controlled with great software. 

Charge Amps - Smart charging made easy

Name: Linjemontage
Description: We specialize in power supply within the voltage range 0.4-400 kV. We market and sell custom power supply solutions and services that provide competitiveness, comfort and security for our customers in utility companies, industry and public administration.

Name: go-e
Description:
The Austrian company go-e GmbH is an internationally operating manufacturer of AC charging stations for electric vehicles with a charging capacity of up to 22 kW. The roots of go-e lie in the search for innovative solutions for e-mobility and the sustainable thinking and actions of the two company founders. They founded the company in 2015 as part of a Kickstarter project for their ONwheel bicycle motor in Feldkirchen, Carinthia, Austria. With this, an electrically powered bicycle could be built from a normal bicycle in the simplest way. Two years later, the start-up presented its first smart charging station for electric cars. With the presentation of the first go-eCharger including high-end equipment at an excellent price-performance ratio, go-e set new standards for charging solutions.

The company, which currently has around 80 employees, has since developed into an internationally established supplier for the production and sale of accessories for e-mobility, especially intelligent AC charging stations. In addition, go-e is active as an OEM development partner as well as an OEM producer and offers its own products as white label. Customers currently receive charging technology from go-e in 20 European countries via a constantly growing network of around 1,000 partners, dealers and specialist companies. go-e is committed to the values of innovative development, a sustainable approach to the environment and social competence in dealing with employees, partners and customers. Production takes place as sustainably as possible at the Austrian company site in Feldkirchen. In addition to the hardware, go-e also develops the software that brings the smart functions of all go-e charging stations to life.

Name: GARO
Description:
GARO is a company that develops, manufactures and markets innovative products and systems for electrical installations under its own brand in the European market. In its four product areas of Electrical distribution products, E-mobility, Project business and Temporary Power, the Group supplies products and complete solutions with a focus on electrical safety, user-friendliness and sustainability. GARO is the market leader in the Nordic region in several product categories within Electrical distribution products and E-mobility.  

Operations are divided into two business areas: GARO Sweden and GARO International.  The Group has sales companies in six countries: Sweden, Norway, Finland, Ireland, the UK and Poland.

GARO was founded in 1939, has its head office in Gnosjö and is today an international Group with around 520 employees. GARO is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm under the ticker name GARO.

Name: Fagerhult Group
Description:
Brightening up people's lives inspired Bertil Svensson to found Fagerhult in 1945. Today, Fagerhult Group is one of Europe's leading lighting companies with 4,100 employees in 27 countries. 

We consist of 12 brands organized into four business areas:

Collection - Exceptional lighting solutions for architectural applications worldwide. 
Our brands include: ateljé Lyktan, iGuzzini, LED Linear and WE-EF

Premium - Lighting solutions for all European markets and for global customers.
Our brands include: Fagerhult and LTS

Professional: Lighting solutions for selected applications, tailored to local market demands.
Our brands include: Arlight, Eagle Lighting and Whitecroft

Infrastructure: Specialty lighting solutions for critical infrastructure and industry applications.  
Our brands include: Designplan, I-Valo and Veko

All our brands produce high-quality professional lighting solutions and we work mainly on specifications together with our partners. Together we cover almost every professional lighting application and our presence is worldwide.

Name: Aimpoint AB
Description:
Ampoint AB is a Swedish company that develops and manufactures red dot sights also called reflex sights. Aimpoint AB is certified according to ISO and all products are developped and manufactured in Sweden.
The company has been on the market since 1975 and has a reputation for being a world leader in its field of technology. 

Aimpoint's high-performance red dot sights are developed to withstand extremely tough handling and environmental situations without adding much weight to the user’s equipment. This combined with excellent optical transmission, LED technology that requires extreme low power consumption and high user-friendliness, Aimpoint red dot sights are the point of reference on the market.
Aimpoint is a trusted supplier and delivers products to almost all NATO members. Today almost 5 millions of Aimpoint red dot sights are on in use worldwide. 
Aimpoint maintains this leading position by listening to the needs of the end users and creating products that can be trusted to perform under the most demanding conditions imaginable, with simplicity, speed and accuracy. 
For Aimpoint,and its employees a sale is not the end of the deal - it’s the start of a commitment to customers and end users. During the product’s whole life cycle, the Aimpoint team will always be there to support its customers.

For more information visit : http://www.aimpoint.com
or send an e-mail to :  info@aimpoint.se 

Aimpoint AB - a company in the Sandberg Development Group http://www.sandbergdevelopment.com/

Name: OSM GROUP
Description:
Since 2004 we have created hundreds of millions of successful, high-quality products shipped to our growing roster of clients worldwide. We specialize in creating cutting-edge engineered soft goods, consumer electronics, and industrial products for renowned global brands. Our passion lies in crafting complex, on-trend creations that captivate consumers and push industry boundaries. 

OSM is Swedish ODM partner for global OEM’s making complex on-trend engineered soft goods, consumer electronics and industrial products. We offer end-to-end Design, R&D and Engineering capabilities. 

The company has more than 1,000 employees. We operate in Hong Kong, China, Philippines, Sweden, US, India.

Our services include:

• End consumer driven design
• Product development
• Scalable mass production
• Retail packaging capabilities and supply chain management solutions

Name: Regin Group
Description:
The Regin Group is a global provider of intuitive solutions for connected buildings. For more than 75 years, we have been dedicated to energy-saving building automation to realize the sustainable buildings of the future.  

Today, the Regin Group consists of three strong product brands – Regin, DEOS, and Industrietechnik. Throughout the group, we work closely with leading property owners, integrators, and installers to develop intelligent solutions that are easy to configure, commission, and install. We offer a complete solution ranging from IoT platforms and software to freely programmable and pre-programmable controllers, and long-lasting field devices.  

Our products are developed at our innovation centers in Sweden and Germany and manufactured in our factories close to our customers. With a team of 550 employees sharing our vision of people’s well-being in a sustainable future, we have achieved a turnover of 972 MSEK. The Regin Group headquarters is located in Kållered, Sweden, with subsidiaries in 9 countries. For more information visit www.regingroup.com

Name: Smeg Nordic
Description:
Not just products. Creations.

Since 1948, Smeg has been a proud Italian brand creating high-quality kitchen appliances. Our journey began with the first cooker in 1955, and for over 70 years now, Smeg appliances have been taking center stage in the heart of homes all over the world. With a distinctive style and a heritage to treasure, we bring an unmatched touch of Italy to every home.

The product range includes a vast choice of Italian inspired cooking appliances - ovens, hobs, range cookers and extractor hoods – as well as an ever expanding range of refrigerators and washing machines. A wide selection of appliances can be viewed at Smeg Nordic's showroom in Malmö and Stockholm.

Go to our website to learn more about our products, shop at our webstore or find your nearest retailer.

Name: Micropower Group
Description: We are a developer and manufacturer of high efficient energy solutions. Experts in industrial battery chargers, Lithium-ion batteries and power converters for industrial applications.

Name: RGNT Motorcycles
Description:
YES, ITS AN ELECTRICAL BIKE and we don’t need to tell you what comes along with that with regards to sustainability, a clean conscience, easy charging, and absolutely, positively zero maintenance. So if you’re hard into leaking fluids, clogged filters and planet-destroying, look elsewhere.

Let’s instead talk about THE RIDING EXPERIENCE. Well, hop on, push a button, ride. As simple as that. Then you’re off to wherever and whatever thanks to one moving part delivering killer torque and smooth acceleration in total silence from the get-go.

Name: Comsys
Description:
Comsys is a cleantech company operating in multiple sectors and segments with one sole purpose, Perfecting Power. With our roots in power electronics and Power Quality we have evolved into a company focusing on everything around power quality and efficient power supply, AC as well as DC. The guiding star has always been to be best in class when it comes to technology and customer satisfaction. The customer satisfaction is reached by offering class leading products, a unique application know how as well as a class leading aftermarket service

ADF has been our main offering since the start in 2001, serving more than 5 000 customers in more than 50 countries; it is now the brand to beat within power quality and active filtering thanks to technologies like sensorless operation, resonance damping, advanced user interface and marine approvals. Further down the road, we added the Netpower DC products to our portfolio, as well as the Magchoke inductor technology. Going forward, all these business areas will be integrated in a wide range of offerings, including solutions such as energy storage, peak shaving, active filtering, solar applications. These solutions can the be applied in a variety of places: grid applications, industrial applications, marine applications, and so forth.

No matter the applications area or solution chosen, we give our customers peace of mind and at the same time a technology no one else can offer. Providing the ultimate toolbox for the energy applications of the future, Comsys is powering the future.

Name: Scanreco
Description:
Scanreco is a world leading supplier of professional radio remote control systems to international machinery, heavy equipment, and crane manufacturers. 

We provide safe, innovative, and reliable radio controls that outlast harsh conditions and help the operator perform at their best.

Together with hydraulic and autonomous machinery and equipment market leaders, we continuously develop new products and systems that are at the leading edge of industry.

As a dedicated service within Scanreco Group; with deep knowledge about products, systems, and hydraulic machinery; Scanreco System Solutions offer retrofit kits and combine Scanreco’s radio remote control systems with value adding key components to form customized complete application solutions for machine control.

Head office is located in Stockholm, Sweden and we have a local presence across the world through own local offices, partners, and carefully assessed system integrators. Founded in Sweden in 1984.


We provide safe, innovative, and reliable radio controls that outlast harsh conditions and help the operator perform at their best.

Our global presence is supported by an expanding network of partners and system integrators. Together with hydraulic and autonomous machinery and equipment market leaders, we continuously develop new products and systems that are at the leading edge of industry.

Founded in Sweden in 1984.

Scanreco | System Solutions

Name: Enerpoly
Description: Enerpoly develops and manufactures zinc-ion batteries to deliver breakthrough affordability in stationary energy storage. The patented technology using globally abundant zinc and manganese is also a safer, cleaner, and scalable solution. Founded in 2018, Enerpoly is headquartered at Stockholm, and brings the best of Swedish design and sustainability to the energy storage industry.

Name: Lab Gruppen
Description:
Lab Gruppen is a global leader in professional audio amplification, renowned for its commitment to innovation, quality, and reliability. With a rich heritage and a passion for pushing the boundaries of audio technology, Lab Gruppen continues to deliver groundbreaking solutions that empower audio professionals to elevate their performances and experiences.

Founded in 1979, Lab Gruppen’s name is one of the world's most respected professional-grade power amplifier manufacturers that is used by major artists, including U2, Philadelphia Eagles, Hamburg Elb Philharmonie, Clair Global, etc.

We obsessively focus on our Customers in the Tour and Live Sound, CEG, Hospitality, and large Venue verticals and believe in providing them with reliable amplification so they can dedicate all your efforts to the performance.

Name: Leine Linde
Description:
Leine Linde is a leading manufacturer of robust encoders, sensors, and system electronics for industrial applications. The products are primarily used for positioning or velocity feedback and known for their robustness, performance and reliability. Our solutions often become the natural choice for heavy-duty operations located in harsh environments. Leine Linde has an active global presence on all continents of the world, working in close cooperation with customers and partners through the local offices and representatives.

The company’s extensive application knowledge, customer focus and state-of-the-art technologies provide added value to original equipment manufacturers and end users worldwide. To us business is long-term where mutual trust is earned each day and in each relationship.

Read more about Leine Linde at www.leinelinde.com

Personal privacy
Leine Linde strives to maintain the privacy for anyone who is in contact with the company, on all occasions. Read more about personal policy at www.leinelinde.com/personal-privacy/

Name: LIGMAN
Description:
LIGMAN’s full ability to design, manufacture and distribute quality lighting fixtures has been well established over the years.

The company is committed to producing world-class, high efficiency and top quality outdoor and indoor lighting products, for which it is now recognised within both the local professional lighting market and internationally.

At LIGMAN, designs are born out of a passion for providing perfect lighting solutions for people. Not just to illuminate the environment in which they live, but created especially with them in mind; going beyond the typical matrices and making genuine differences to enhance lives  – Living Lighting.

Utilizing state of the art advanced modern technology, the highest level of technical expertise and innovative designs, LIGMAN is committed to ensuring product quality and offering total lighting solutions for their customers, with every lighting component used in their luminaires carefully considered and of the highest quality.

LIGMAN is continuously expanding its global footprints and ready to provide their customers with excellent service and collaboration to offer greater lighting solutions for people.

PRODUCTS: https://ligman.com/products

WEB: https://ligman.com

Name: Aura Light
Description:
Aura Light provides lighting that is smart; sustainable, economical, long lasting, high quality and environmentally friendly. We call it Brighter Lighting.
Our sustainable lighting solutions enable professional customers to reduce cost, energy consumption and carbon footprint.

Name: J2 Sourcing
Description:
J2 Sourcing is an independent distributor of electronic components. We serve companies ranging from global EMS companies and distributors to small and local manufacturers. J2 Sourcing offers not only solutions to component shortages but also different services aimed at handling our customer's excess. 

Our technical-skilled and procurement-experienced staff speaks 30 different languages to handle dialogue with customers and providers.

J2 Sourcing has been engaged in the distribution of electronic components to the industry since 2004. We make sure that our customers obtain components quickly and inexpensively, and we assist them in disposing of any excess inventory. This can be summed up as availability, cost savings, and excess.

Name: NOTE
Description:
NOTE produces PCBAs, subassemblies and box build products. NOTE is a competitive EMS provider and stable business partner to customers with high standards. NOTE’s products are embedded in complex systems for electronic control, surveillance and security, for example. 

NOTE’s business model builds on delivering high end manufacture, custom logistics solutions and consulting for the best possible total cost through long-term customer relationships and partnerships. Its customer offering covers complete product lifecycles, from design to after-sales. Primarily, its customer base consists of large corporations operating on the global market, and enterprises whose main sales are in northern Europe. 

NOTE has a presence in Sweden, Finland, the UK, Estonia, Bulgaria and China. Sales 2024 were SEK 3.901 million, and the group has approximately 1,500 employees.
NOTE is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. For more information, please go to www.note-ems.com.

Name: DV Power
Description:
IBEKO Power AB, with headquarters in Stockholm (Sweden) and best known through the brand ”DV Power”, has since 2000 developed radically light and ingenious test solutions for transformers, circuit breakers, and batteries.

The company was founded by a group of engineers with deep knowledge and experience in the power electronics technology area. Today our DV Power products are sold worldwide – in over 110 countries – and we are still focusing on extensive research and development. Thanks to all our customers that provide us with continuous case studies and feedback, we are able to build even better products that serve our customers’ needs.

Our success is solely based on extensive research, development, and fast commercial application.

Products:

- Circuit Breaker Test Equipment
- Transformer Test Equipment
- Motor Test Equipment
- Battery Test Equipment
- Safety Test Equipment

The price list and additional information on delivery terms can be received from the DV Power area/country distributor or directly via e-mail: sales@dv-power.com.

Our technical support is always available to help you. You may call at +46 70 0925 000 or e-mail support@dv-power.com.

Name: Hide-a-lite by Elektro Elco AB
Description: Elektro Elco AB utvecklar och marknadsför belysningslösningar till privat och offentlig miljö. Produkterna säljs i huvudsak under det egna varumärket Hide-a-lite. Försäljningen sker främst till installatörer via grossister, samt "gör det själv butiker" och butikskedjor.

Name: CDVI Nordic AB
Description:
Välkommen till CDVI! Den bästa platsen för dig att vara på. Det är ju här du hittar driftsäkra accesslösningar inom lås, passersystem och dörrautomatik. Produkter som är enkla att installera, programmera – och framför allt att använda. Nämnde vi att de är genomtänkta och snygga, och att de funkar lika bra i en enskild källardörr som i passersystem för hela kvarter? 

CDVI Group är en internationell grupp av företag med huvudkontor i Paris. CDVI Nordic finns med kontor i Göteborg och ansvarar för den Skandinaviska och Baltiska marknaden.

Name: Mycronic PCB Assembly Solutions
Description:
As the pace of change accelerates, we’re convinced that tomorrow’s PCB assembly environment should be a simpler place. A place where no build schedule is too complex. No defect goes unprevented. And no production is left standing still. From naked board to coated product –and everything in between.

Bring us your bottlenecks, your quality issues and your integration challenges. And put our process experts to the test. Together, we can build the future of flexibility.

Mycronic PCB assembly solutions
Mycronic is a leading global provider of flexible, printed-circuit board (PCB) assembly solutions, with a comprehensive full-line offering in the high-mix manufacturing segment.

Our team of experts have decades of experience in the industry and are here to provide you with tailored solutions that fit your unique needs.

We develop a wide range of products within jet printing, solder paste inspection, component placement, automated optical inspection, component storage, dispensing, coating and process software. 

Services
Our customer service representatives are available to answer any questions you may have and provide you with the best solution for your needs. We understand the importance of having a reliable partner for your SMT and Dispensing needs, and we are here to help. Please contact us with any questions you may have.

Thank you for considering Mycronic PCB assembly solutions. We look forward to working with you!

Name: SafeLine Group
Description:
SafeLine is a Swedish company that manufactures safety accessories for lifts. We have over 350 000 installed lift telephones which makes us the largest independent manufacturer specialising in lift safety products in Europe.

We know that our lives are impacted every day by rapid improvements in technology. Changes are happening quickly, and there is no way of knowing exactly what the future holds – to know where we're going.

With a shifting and complex technical landscape, it's easy to get lost. Lift safety used to be just a physical phone line but is today so much more. This of course means a big change for both you and us. But it also means a great opportunity for us to become more time-efficient – to work smarter instead of harder.

That’s why we’ve taken upon ourselves to guide our customers towards the future of lift safety, to take on the challenges posed by this changing technological landscape – something we like to call the SafeLine journey. A journey you are all invited to take with us.

Let’s get going.

Name: Holtab
Description:
Electrical power is a business critical resource in society and our offering focuses on the Energy Distribution, Renewable Energy, Industry and Infrastructure segments. In each segment, we also have specific industry solutions tailored to the unique needs of our customers.

Our products include secondary substations, primary substations, technical buildings and low-voltage switchgear. Our core values are the backbone of everything we do – know-how, service and cooperation.

We have a unique way of working with prefabricated solutions in an industrial environment. As we are independent in our choice of technology and can install various makes of electrical power products in all our products, we have great flexibility and guaranteed quality. The industrial environment also offers unique opportunities during the configuration and test phase as we can check each individual product directly against our customers' live operations environments prior to delivery. By delivering a completely tested product, the amount of work and risks in the field are reduced.

Read about our current products, interesting customer cases and what is in the pipeline for us and the industry: http://www.holtab.com

Name: RS Scandinavia
Description:
Our mission is simple: to make amazing happen for a better world. 

Welcome to RS Scandinavia! 
We are a global B2B multichannel distributor, revolutionising the industrial and electronics industries. We provide product and service solutions to meet the industrial and engineering challenges of today and tomorrow. With over 8000 employees in 31 locations worldwide, we combine our global expertise with a local human touch to serve you better. We connect you with 2500 world-leading suppliers, including our own brand, RS Pro, and stock over 750,000 products to ensure you receive the latest technologies within just a few days.

Since 1992, our Scandinavian team has been serving businesses of all sizes across multiple industries -including Food & Beverage, Transportation, Manufacturing, Pharmaceuticals, and so much more. Today, we empower over 25.000 customers across Denmark, Sweden, and Norway.

Our commitment to you goes beyond just providing products. We offer a robust set of value-added services and solutions, constantly evolving to meet your needs. From procurement to calibration and oil testing, we're working directly with you to understand your challenges.

Based in Copenhagen, our Scandinavian headquarters comprises 80+ team members representing all three Scandinavian nationalities. They are dedicated to supporting you through account management, technical assistance, and cost optimisation. 

At RS, our values are at the core of everything we do; we are committed to sustainability and making a positive impact. RS embraces an ambitious ESG roadmap, championing engineers of tomorrow, igniting inspiration, and fuelling innovation. We actively work to minimise our environmental footprint with sustainable practices and ethically sourced supply solutions.

But...we're not just about global goals; our Scandinavian team takes part in volunteer initiatives to make a difference in our local communities. In April, we collected over 50 kgs of waste in Copenhagen, in 4 hours.

Name: Alp Electronix
Description:
OUR STORY
Alp Electronix (NanoVolt AB) started as a company 2022 in Västerås, Sweden. The story started with our CEO, Caner Alp, who was born with a passionate interest of technology, electronics and developing solutions. Throughout the education he had a good mentorship with researchers, experts and professionals, while developing new concepts and solutions into reality. Collaboration and sharing knowledge has always been close to heart, so throughout the years mentorship, working as teacher, performing trainings and more is a natural part of his philosophy. Working professionally several years as a development and analysis engineer within industrial electronics further strengthened his experience, and widened the field of opportunities. Later years the idea of realizing the passion and competence into real value started. By dedicated work, collaboration with competent partners and like-minded friends, the company soon became reality.

We are happy to invite you to boost your passion and electronics career together!

BUSINESS CONCEPT
We aim our company to provide you as a small scale electronics developer with the base material you need to be able to focus on putting your ideas into functional electronics. We provide consumables, development kits and boards, support and more. Besides this, we aim to include training in form of online webinars, on-site hands-on training and consultancy. Further, Alp Electronix will act as a reliable, flexible and dedicated fast-turnaround
development partner to your company within the automation and electronics sector. We provide you and your business with off the shelf solutions, with experience of cooperating with your R&D function, within Hardware Development and Embedded systems.

Contact us for more info and queries contact@alpelectronix.com

Name: Evertiq - Global
Description:
Welcome to Evertiq, First in Electronics News and Expo.

We are more than just a news network; we are a dynamic global media brand dedicated to serving the Electronics Design and Manufacturing Supply Chain worldwide through a variety of platforms for news and information, accessible both online and offline. 

Who We Are:
Founded in Sweden in 1999, Evertiq has evolved into a global force, annually attracting over 1 million visitors. Our expanding international team of content creators report on the very latest electronic design and manufacturing news, provide insightful analyst reports, and tailor market updates exclusively for the electronics sector. 

Global Reach:
At Evertiq, our commitment extends beyond providing news; we are a catalyst for industry connections, hosting several one-day expos all over the world that unite the electronics industry. Consistently at the forefront of global electronics news, Evertiq’s online platforms cater for audiences in Germany, Mexico, Sweden, Poland, France, Finland, Spain, and our central global news hub attracts viewers from the USA, China, and Europe.

Name: NVC Lighting APAC
Description:
NVC Lighting was established in late 1998. It has always been committed to independent innovation in product research and development, and is dedicated to providing efficient, energy-saving, healthy and comfortable lighting environments and solutions for areas such as architecture, transportation, urban lighting, commercial and supermarket spaces, hotels, offices, homes and industry.

On May 20, 2010, NVC Lighting was listed on the Main Board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (stock code: 02222HK). It has become the most influential leading company in China's lighting industry. In June 2017, it was recognized as one of China's 500 most valuable brands and ranked first in the "2016 Top 100 Enterprises in China's LED Lighting and Decoration Industry". In 2019, its brand value reached 32.695 billion yuan, maintaining its leading position in China's lighting industry for eight consecutive years. In the "2018 Top 100 Enterprises in China's LED Lighting and Decoration Industry" released in June 2019, NVC Lighting achieved an annual revenue of over 10 billion yuan for two consecutive years, winning the "Top 10 Brands in China's Lighting Industry in 2018", becoming the first enterprise in China's lighting industry to achieve an annual revenue of over 10 billion yuan for two consecutive years.

NVC Lighting has four manufacturing bases and two internationally standardized R&D centers and nationally accredited laboratories in China, as well as 38 operation centers and over 3,800 brand stores. Overseas, the company has set up operating agencies in more than 40 countries and regions, and established a product development center that meets European standards.

You can also contact us by e-mail: hello@nvc-international.com

Name: Backer
Description:
Every time you turn on an electric appliance or warm up your home, there's a high probability that Backer has had a hand in crafting the solution. 

With approximately 3,000 employees globally, Backer is a premier supplier of heating solutions and components for a diverse range of applications in more than 100 countries. Our product portfolio includes sophisticated heating elements and systems for household appliances, industrial applications, and HVAC systems, designed to deliver not only comfort but also energy efficiency.

Stay connected for updates on career opportunities. Join us at Backer in engineering innovative solutions that enhance everyday life and contribute to a sustainable future. Be part of a dynamic and evolving company that offers numerous opportunities across the globe. Curious about our vacancies? Explore our career site at Hem (backer.se)

Backer is part of NIBE Element, belonging to the NIBE Group, a leading global provider in the heating industry. NIBE Group is a publicly listed company on the Stockholm Stock Exchange. Today, NIBE Group employs around 18,000 people worldwide with annual sales of about SEK 30 billion.

At Backer, we are committed to improving energy efficiency and reducing environmental impact through our cutting-edge heating technology and solutions, helping people achieve more comfortable and sustainable living environments.

Name: Senseair
Description: Senseair AB is a leading global provider of air and gas sensing technology. Our purpose is to make sense of air by providing the best possible measurement solutions, services, and intelligence. With over 25 years of experience, Senseair has become the centre of excellence in the field of non-dispersive infrared (NDIR) technology. We develop and produce the smallest and most cost-efficient high-precision low-power sensors for high volume production.

Name: Amokabel AB
Description:
The Amokabel Group is a private own company group consisting of three manufacturing cable companies with subsidiary companies, producing everything from automotive wire to covered conductors. By keeping a narrow range of products we are able to be “best in the business” in these products. Besides our key business we also invest money in hydroelectric power and real estate.

The first company in the Amokabel Group was founded in 1992. Since then we have embarked on a continuous process of expansion and modernization which has enabled us to become a very profitable and successful Cable Group. The relentless quest for growth resulted during the 1990 ́s in a number of new producing companies within the group but also new companies in hydroelectric power and real estate sector.

The location for the cable production is in Alstermo, 70 km from Växjö and Kalmar. We manufacture thousands of different types of wires and cables, and are geared to design and produce a large variety of custom-made cables.


Amokabel – Cable for life

Name: Inission
Description: Inission is a total supplier of customized manufacturing services and products in advanced industrial electronics and mechanics. Our services cover the entire product life cycle, from development and design to industrialization, volume production and aftermarket services. Inission has operations in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Estonia, Italy, the USA, and Tunisia. Inission has a strong value-driven corporate culture of entrepreneurship and passion, which has 2023 resulted in a turnover of approx. SEK 2,2 billion with approx. 1 100 employees. Inission is listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market. Inission’s offer is divided into two business areas; Contract manufacturing of electronic and mechanical products under the brand Inission and Power electronics and systems under the brand Enedo.

Name: ImpulseRadar
Description:
ImpulseRadar develops and builds ground penetrating radar (GPR) instruments and related software. We are the only GPR manufacturer offering an entire product line that utilizes the latest real-time sampling technology. This design concept provides significant operational and performance benefits over older designs. We support our advanced hardware with excellent user interfaces and improved processing software, which are simple, clean, intuitive, and reliable.  

When it comes to investigating and mapping subsurface features and structures, we know our customers often face complex challenges. But you want tools that enable you to overcome these in a quick, straightforward, and dependable way. Because of this, we focus our efforts on areas where we can make a clear difference in functionality, user-friendliness, and system performance. Our proven GPR technology will help you maximize your productivity and decision-making capabilities while driving results across a wide range of application areas.

As an established company, we have an international network for sales and support. We are also Triple-A (AAA) rated by Dun & Bradstreet, in recognition of our high creditworthiness and capacity for meeting payment liabilities. So please put your trust in us and become part of the ImpulseRadar user community.  

We are here to help you – contact us today

Name: Sigma Lundinova AB
Description: Sigma Lundinova is a development house for IT, telecom, life science, and industry. We offer the entire chain in the processes of design and manufacturing; from concept study to testing and production. We take the full responsibility for your entire project, or handle parts of it.

Name: Nilar
Description:
Swedish-based Nilar International AB develops and manufactures batteries that are part of stationary energy storage systems. With better energy storage, society can support the increasingly stressed electricity grid by bridging imbalances between energy production and demand, especially important as the share of renewable energy sources increases. Nilar's battery technology is based on nickel metal hydride (NiMH) electrochemistry with a water-based electrolyte, which provides both higher safety and better performance while allowing the components to be recycled and reused. Nilar has its headquarters in Täby and since 2012 all batteries have been developed and produced in the production facility in Gävle, which is powered by 100% renewable energy.

The Nilar share is listed on the Nasdaq First North Premier Growth Market under the ticker NILAR. FNCA Sweden is Certified Adviser 08-528 00 399. For more information see www.nilar.com.

Name: Hager Sverige
Description:
Tillsammans bygger vi en bättre framtid

I över 70 år har Hager format elbranschen med produkter, lösningar och tjänster för bostäder, företag och industrier. Sortimentet omfattar eldistribution och energihantering, kanalisation, strömställarsystem, e-mobilitet samt intelligenta styrsystem för byggnader. Vi lyssnar, utvecklar och stöttar dig i dina projekt. Från projektering till färdigställande. Och vi finns alltid redo att besvara dina frågor.

För en mer hållbar framtid

Vi tänker i nya banor kring elektricitet för att skapa en effektivare och renare planet. Våra team utvecklar smarta, miljövänliga material och skapar innovativa lösningar som gör livet bättre. För som vi alla vet: framtiden väntar inte. 

Den underliggande idén med allt vi gör är att gynna våra kunder och lägger stor vikt vid enkelhet och användarvänlighet. Vi är innovativa och arbetar kontinuerligt på att förbättra och förenkla våra produkter och tjänster för våra kunder. 

Hager är ett familjeägt företag med mer än 13,000 anställda, tillverkning på 23 platser runt om i världen och kunder i mer än 100 länder. Vi skapar produkter och lösningar, för bostäder och kommersiella fastigheter, som erbjuder sinnesro, säkerhet och välbefinnande för människor i deras dagliga liv.

Vi arbetar efter klart definierade värderingar. Vi investerar i våra anställda och deras kompetensutveckling samt arbetar aktivt med vårt ekologiska fotavtryck genom att utveckla processer och lösningar som är mer energieffektiva. Att tänka och agera på lång sikt hjälper oss systematiskt att undvika risker och utnyttja möjligheter tidigare och med större genomslag. Hållbarhet är därför nyckeln till vår långsiktiga framgång.

Name: SOMMER Antriebs- und Funktechnik GmbH
Description:
The SOMMER Antriebs- und Funktechnik GmbH (the subsidiary SOMMER DOCO in UK) is one of the leading manufacturers of high-quality garage door operators, swing gate operators, sliding gate operators, roller shutter operators and awning operators as well as radio remote controls for home automation in Europe.

SOMMER places great value on excellent quality and outstanding service. For this reason, we sell our manufactured products exclusively via specialist retailers. Certification according to DIN EN ISO 9001 was granted in 1995. The customer-oriented SOMMER company philosophy has been codified in a set of company guidelines.

With an export ratio of approx. 80%, SOMMER has underscored its international competitiveness and successfully made inroads into the sometimes difficult foreign markets with "Quality made in Germany".

The SOMMER Group consists of SOMMER Antriebs- und Funktechnik GmbH, APERTO Torantriebe GmbH, Groke Türen GmbH, metaku Metall- und Kunststoffbau GmbH, Triebenbacher Betriebsgesellschaft mbH and DOCO International B.V. We are globally active with our own branch offices and representatives.

Legal information: https://www.sommer.eu/en/legal-information.html

Name: OPSIS AB
Description:
OPSIS AB develops, manufactures, and sells instruments and software for monitoring air quality and gas emissions in both ambient environments and industrial processes.

We provide measurement solutions for:
• ambient air quality monitoring (air pollution in outdoor environments)
• industrial emissions and process gas monitoring
• laboratory analysis instruments for the food industry and other sectors (LiquidLINE and Liquid Monitoring)

Our systems are used by environmental authorities, industrial companies, and laboratories to accurately measure, monitor, and report air pollution and gas emissions.

OPSIS operates globally, with direct presence in Sweden, Denmark, and Norway. In other markets, we work through a worldwide network of subsidiaries, distributors, and partners who provide sales, installation, and service support.

Name: CrossControl AB
Description:
CrossControl supports OEMs and System Suppliers in making industrial vehicles smarter, safer and more productive. We offer a platform for machine intelligence that includes a wide portfolio of hardware, software and services.

CrossControl is part of Scanreco Group, a world leader in professional radio remote control systems. The group delivers solutions for safety critical and demanding mobile hydraulic machinery and heavy equipment worldwide. Scanreco is known for its long experience and focus on rugged, reliable, safe, and user centric solutions. CrossControl operates as a specialized part of this global organization. 

Career opportunities at CrossControl
The key to our success is dedicated and competent employees. We need persons who can deal with tough requirements, persons who know the importance of interaction between human and machine. Do you have a desire to constantly develop your skills? Have you got experience from tough requirements and critical environments? 

Our technology department is searching for senior and junior engineers. We work with full scale product development projects from technical sales and proposal preparations to verifications, deliveries, product support and expert engineering for our customer. Do you want to be part of developing our future?

Name: Ligna Energy
Description: We believe in a future where technology and nature works close together. This philosophy is reflected in our unique material recipe that utilizes waste from forest industries in our products, solving the challenges of battery scrap while repurposing waste from other industries at the same time.

Name: Cobolt AB, a part of HÜBNER Photonics
Description:
Cobolt AB (Stockholm, Sweden), a HÜBNER Photonics Company, is committed to supplying high performance and innovative lasers that meet or exceed the market's expectations concerning quality, reliability and robustness. Through continuous technology development, customer orientation and an ISO certified quality management system, Cobolt has become a preferred supplier of lasers to major instrument manufacturers and leading research labs. 
By supporting the development of innovative, cutting-edge applications in the areas of super-resolution microscopy, flow cytometry, Raman spectroscopy and metrology, the Cobolt lasers can contribute to advancing the understanding and defeating of severe diseases, to improvements in quality of life and a better environment.

Name: Panasonic Fire & Security Europe AB
Description: Panasonic Fire & Security Europe is a global leader in fire detection and alarm systems, with over 35 years of continuous innovation and a commitment to the highest quality standards. Our systems are easy to install and maintain and can be customized to fit the specific needs of your business. They offer reliable fire detection based on true artificial intelligence, as well as remote monitoring and integration options. Our team of passionate professionals is dedicated to providing innovative products and solutions that keep you and your facilities safe.

Name: NexBlue
Description:
NexBlue develops charging and energy systems that make everyday energy use simple, affordable, and reliable.

Our smart chargers adapt to the grid, update themselves over the air, and support cleaner ways of driving and living.

We contribute to the mass adoption of electric vehicles by focusing on what matters: ease of installation, safety, and long-term relevance.

Be current. Always forward

Name: ENEQUI
Description:
Take charge of your energy supply!
Rising electrification demands smarter energy solutions. Solutions that make energy storage simpler, car charging easier and costs more controllable. Name: SAMON
Description:
Since 1990, SAMON has been manufacturing simply reliable refrigerant gas detectors.

Effective refrigerant leak detection is essential for safety, environmental, and economic reasons.

Secure and sustainable solutions for tomorrow's electrified society.

cable crimping systems for electrical connectors since 1959.

Description:

We also develop hardware modules that can be integrated by our partners globally. 

Please visit our webpage to read more about our solutions, http://www.aliaro.com

Name: ScandiNova Systems
Description:
With a rich legacy of expertise and innovation, ScandiNova Systems (ScandiNova) has established itself as a world leader in the development and production of high-voltage pulsed power systems for MedTech, Industrial, and Science applications. The product range includes magnetron modulators, klystron based RF units, e-gun modulators, and pulse generators.

Operating on a global scale, ScandiNova exports more than 95% of its production to clients in 47 countries, predominantly in Europe, Asia, and North America. Founded in 2001 by individuals with extensive commercial and technical experience in pulsed-power applications, ScandiNova has continually pushed the boundaries of technological advancement.

Headquartered in Uppsala, Sweden, and with a dedicated team of over 240 employees, the Group delivers cutting-edge technologies worldwide. In close collaboration with our customers, we drive progress in sectors such as MedTech, scientific research, and industrial applications. See www.nodicagroup.com

Name: LAPP Sweden
Description:
Official page of LAPP Sweden

We combine one of the market's widest ranges of cables, special cables, cable accessories, electrical components, enclosures and automation products with high technical expertise and qualified advice. Our head office is located in Nyköping with warehouse, logistics centers and resources for customized manufacturing. A local office for the Danish market is located in Greve, south of Copenhagen.

Name: Alelion Energy Systems AB (publ)
Description:
Alelion Energy Systems AB (publ) – enabling the sustainable use of energy through our lithium ion energy storage and intelligent control system solutions.
 
Alelion drives sustainability in the load- and materials- handling industry. We’re powering up the future with our Alelion battery management ecosystem and its leading edge lithium-ion technology.

We develop, manufacture and deliver tailor-made lithium Ion batteries, power electronics and control systems for the needs of today, whilst we design the power supplies of tomorrow. Alelion has proven expertise in delivery as well as a reputation for industry-leading innovation in the growing field of sustainable li-ion battery technologies. 
 
Over the last decade, Alelion has taken charge of the entire battery management value chain to enable their customers to focus on profitability and efficiency, always in the greenest way.
 
Alelion Batteries AB was founded in 2006 and is a spin-off from ETC Batteries and Fuelcells, a R&D company for advanced energy solutions.
